parts.label: a
parts.ask: Relative to a fixed origin \(O\), \(A\) has position vector \(5\mathbf{i} + 3\mathbf{j} + 2\mathbf{k}\). Show that \(\left|\overrightarrow{OA}\right| = \sqrt{38}\).

steps.why: Show how 38 is made from the components: it's a show-that.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: \(B\) has position vector \(2\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} + a\mathbf{k}\), where \(a\) is a positive integer. Find the smallest value of \(a\) for which \(\left|\overrightarrow{OB}\right| > \left|\overrightarrow{OA}\right|\).

steps.why: Both sides are positive, so squaring is safe.

steps.text: \(a\) is an integer, so take the next one up. Check: \(a = 5\) gives \(\sqrt{45} > \sqrt{38}\), but \(a = 4\) gives \(\sqrt{36} < \sqrt{38}\).
